correctness.rationale: For all odd prime powers r>=5, h>=2 and permitted coefficient vectors, smoothness follows from derivative -1 in y, unique infinity from deg xR(x)=r^h+1 prime to p, and the invariant affine monomial basis produces all quotient pole orders without cancellation because distinct j have distinct residues mod r. The Apéry staircase, minimal generators, gaps, pseudo-Frobenius set and weight are then exact symbolic identities. Independent finite exact-arithmetic DP checks corroborated 28 samples, including r=9,25; not a universal proof.

originality.rationale: Bartoli et al. (arXiv:2610.35788v1) describe the tame scalar quotient, ramification, genus, rigidity and gonality; their inspected relevant sections do not present the marked-point Apéry staircase, minimal semigroup, pseudo-Frobenius set, or weight. Full-text inspections of the 2015 additive cover and 2026 linearized-Galois semigroup results reveal distinct objects and hypotheses. A previous larger scalar quotient has different degree and genus. The conclusion is a best-knowledge originality assessment, not a priority certificate.

The originality assessment is not an independent historical-priority certification.

value.rationale: The marked infinity point and minimal-degree rational map are intrinsic to the construction of new high-genus curves. The full Apéry system yields every one-point Riemann--Roch dimension and hence algebraic-geometric code parameters. The uniform coefficient-independent semigroup and its type and positive weight across an unbounded family of curves are mathematically meaningful structural invariants, not arbitrary small-parameter computations.
